submission.justification: Crystal-K2 at 4 cm gives the best 662 keV resolution in the thickness sweep (2.946%). Next best are K2 at 6 cm (2.975%) and K1 at 4 cm (4.335%). K3 is worst at every thickness (8.3% or more). K2 is preferred on resolution, but this recommendation is conditional. The hard background constraint (intrinsic background 100-3000 keV at or below 0.5 counts/kg/day) is not verified. No candidate has a documented intrinsic background, and background_verified_flag = 0. The brief requires that constraint to be met, so K2 should not be procured or adopted until its background is measured or documented and shown to be within budget. If it fails, K1 (4.335% at 4 cm) is the next option to check, since its background is also unverified. Note also a discrepancy: a separate record gives K2 at 5 cm as 2.9%, which is slightly better than the 4 cm sweep value. It is not part of the 2/4/6/8/10 cm sweep, so I did not select it. It should be checked if 5 cm is considered.
